source_issues.evidence: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'litellm' - app fails to start with no helpful error message

source_issues.title: Uncaught ImportError in utils.py line 43
source_issues.evidence: ImportError: cannot import name '_parsing' from 'openai.lib' - openai package version mismatch causes startup crash on macOS

source_issues.title: Uncaught RuntimeError in pathlib.py line 1074
source_issues.evidence: RuntimeError: Symlink loop - app crashes when repo contains circular symlinks

source_issues.title: Uncaught NotImplementedError in pathlib.py line 1090
source_issues.evidence: NotImplementedError: Non-relative patterns are unsupported - app crashes on Windows when /read-only command is used with absolute glob pattern

source_issues.title: Uncaught TypeError in pathlib.py line 373
source_issues.evidence: TypeError: argument should be a str or an os.PathLike object where __fspath__ returns a str, not 'NoneType' - app crashes when not run inside a git repo

source_issues.title: Uncaught FileNotFoundError in ssl.py line 707
source_issues.evidence: FileNotFoundError when SSL_CERT_FILE env var points to non-existent file - app crashes on startup on Windows when SSL env is misconfigured

source_issues.title: ffff
source_issues.evidence: PermissionError during git config lock acquisition in system32 directory - app fails to start with cryptic OSError on Windows when cwd is elevated

source_issues.title: Uncaught ValueError in exceptions.py line 71
source_issues.evidence: Duplicate of #4978 - ValueError: PermissionDeniedError is in litellm but not in aider's exceptions list

signals.topic: /voice command only supports OpenAI Whisper API, failing for all other LLM providers
signals.summary: The /voice command unconditionally requires OpenAI's Whisper API, producing an opaque error for users of other LLM providers. Users cannot use voice input at all unless they pay for and use OpenAI models.
aliases: Voice mode requires OpenAI Whisper, broken for non-OpenAI users
No local STT support for /voice command
signals.review_reason: Key feature (/voice) is completely non-functional for all non-OpenAI users, with only a cryptic error message and no guidance. Users report being unable to use the feature at all, which is a significant UX failure for a prominently advertised feature. Count=1 but high user impact as voice input is a core interactive feature.

source_issues.title: Feature request: local-only Whisper mode by default
source_issues.evidence: User reports cryptic error 'could not find suitable handler for whisper-1' when using /voice with non-OpenAI model. Voice input is completely unusable for non-OpenAI users. User-provided implementation using faster-whisper demonstrates the gap.

signals.topic: Ollama models reload from disk on every request instead of staying in memory
signals.summary: When using Ollama with GPU-loaded models, aider triggers model reloading on every user prompt, causing significant latency and GPU thrashing. The same Ollama instance works correctly via OpenWebUI.
aliases: Ollama model reloads on each prompt causing latency
signals.review_reason: Significant performance degradation: models reload on every request instead of staying in GPU memory, causing measurable latency increase and GPU thrashing. User has confirmed the same Ollama setup works via OpenWebUI, isolating the problem to aider's Ollama integration. count=1 but the behavior is clearly abnormal and user-impacting.

source_issues.title: Ollama keeps unloading my models each request
source_issues.evidence: GPU memory graphs show models loading and unloading on every single request. Same Ollama instance works fine via OpenWebUI, proving the issue is specific to aider's interaction with Ollama. Causes significant latency per request.

signals.topic: GUI mode (Streamlit) fails to start when default port is occupied
signals.summary: When running aider's GUI mode (Streamlit-based), the app crashes with RetriesExceededError if port 8601 is unavailable, preventing GUI launch without manual port configuration.
aliases: GUI mode fails to start on port conflict
signals.review_reason: GUI mode crashes due to port conflict with no graceful fallback or helpful error message. Count=1 and GUI is secondary feature, but causes complete failure of the GUI workflow without guidance on how to resolve.

source_issues.title: Uncaught RetriesExceededError in server.py line 284
source_issues.evidence: RetriesExceededError: Cannot start Streamlit server. Port 8601 is not available, and Streamlit was unable to find a free port after 100 attempts. GUI completely unusable without manual intervention.

signals.topic: Context window full error gives no actionable guidance to user
signals.summary: When the AI context window fills up, aider throws an error instead of proactively offering to clear chat history or remove files, forcing users to diagnose and resolve manually.
aliases: No user guidance when context window is full
signals.review_reason: User-facing error with no actionable guidance is a UX failure that disrupts workflow. While count=1, the issue has been open since 2024 and labeled as enhancement, indicating persistent user friction. No user impact evidence beyond the enhancement request itself.

source_issues.title: [FeatReq] Ask the user to remove some files or to clear the chat history when the AI context is full instead of giving error
source_issues.evidence: User encounters opaque error when context window is full with no guidance on how to resolve - must manually figure out what files to remove or how to clear history.

signals.topic: 多 Provider 评测时 max_tokens 配置跨 Provider 泄漏导致 API 403 错误
signals.summary: 多 Provider 评测场景下，某个 Provider 配置的 max_tokens 参数会泄漏到其他未显式设置该参数的 Provider API 请求中，导致使用新版 OpenAI 模型（拒绝 max_tokens、要求 max_completion_tokens）的 Provider 调用直接返回 HTTP 403，评测流程阻断。
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断 Bug：用户配置多个 Provider 进行对比评测时，因内部配置泄漏导致部分 Provider 的 API 调用直接返回 403 错误，评测流程完全失败。bug 明确（配置文件隔离失效）、复现路径清晰（多 Provider YAML 配置 + 运行 eval）、有完整 workaround（需用 --filter-providers 拆分为多次独立命令），严重影响多模型对比评测这一核心使用场景。

source_issues.title: max_tokens config leaks across providers in multi-provider eval
source_issues.evidence: 在多 Provider 评测中，设置 gpt-4.1-mini 的 max_tokens: 16000 导致 gpt-5.4-mini 调用时也收到该参数，OpenAI API 返回 HTTP 403。Provider 配置未实现隔离。

signals.topic: openai:agents 内置 Provider 无法传递多模态（图像）输入给 Agent
signals.summary: openai:agents 内置 Provider 将渲染后的 prompt 作为纯字符串传给 run()，SDK 的 toAgentInputList() 将字符串转为纯文本消息，导致多模态输入（如 base64 编码图像）以原始文本形式传递而非 vision content block，模型无法看到图像，评测失败。
signals.review_reason: 核心功能不可用：openai:agents Provider 是 promptfoo 官方内置的 OpenAI Agent 集成方式，但无法支持图像等多模态输入，导致使用 Agent + 视觉模型的评测场景完全无法工作。用户被迫放弃内置 Provider 自行实现，变相降低了工具的可用性和官方集成的可靠性。

source_issues.title: openai:agents built-in provider cannot pass multimodal (image) input to the agent
source_issues.evidence: YAML prompt 模板通过 {{image_b64}} 嵌入 base64 图像，Agent 收到的不是 vision content block（type: input_image）而是原始 base64 文本，模型无法处理，评测失败。用户只能绕过内置 Provider 写自定义 TypeScript provider。

signals.topic: TypeScript Provider 导入其他 .ts 文件时报 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND 错误
signals.summary: TypeScript Provider 文件导入项目中的其他 .ts 文件时，promptfoo 仅转译 Provider 本身，未处理其传递性的 .ts 依赖，导致 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND，Native TypeScript 支持形同虚设。
signals.review_reason: 体验显著下降：官方宣传 Native TypeScript Provider 支持，用户按文档使用时报错。只有在额外安装 tsx 并设置 NODE_OPTIONS 后才能工作，增加了认知负担和配置复杂度。且此模式是项目共用代码（provider 复用项目内部 lib）的常见合理需求，非边缘场景。

source_issues.title: TypeScript provider fails when importing other .ts files from the project
source_issues.evidence: Provider 导入项目共享的 .ts 模块时报错 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND。workaround 需要设置 NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' 并添加 tsx 依赖。Native TypeScript 支持的核心承诺未兑现。

signals.topic: JavaScript 断言 type=javascript 不支持传入参数变量
signals.summary: JavaScript 类型的断言不支持通过独立参数注入测试参数，只能复用 test vars，但 test vars 有特定用途（影响测试报告展示），且是全局共享的，无法为同一测试用例的不同断言设置不同参数值，限制了断言的复用性和可读性。
signals.review_reason: 功能性缺陷：其他断言类型（contains、equals 等）均支持通过 config 传入参数，但 JavaScript 断言缺失此能力，导致用户在编写参数化断言时体验不一致，被迫使用 workaround 或放弃使用 JavaScript 断言，转用其他断言类型绕行。

source_issues.title: Feature Request: javascript assertions supporting parameters
source_issues.evidence: 用户希望为同一断言类型复用不同阈值参数，但 test vars 会影响报告展示且全局共享，无法精细化控制断言参数。

signals.topic: not-javascript 断言类型在 number/function/object 等 value 类型下不工作
signals.summary: handleJavascript() 函数中，inverse 参数仅在 assertion.value 为 boolean 时检查，number、function、object 等其他 value 类型下 not-javascript 断言逻辑缺失，导致本应失败的断言意外通过，评测结果不准确。
signals.review_reason: 评测准确性 Bug：not-javascript 断言在多种 value 类型下失效，本应检测 JavaScript 内容的场景下无法正确判定 pass/fail，导致评测结果不可信。虽然只影响一种断言子类型，但直接影响评测正确性这一核心价值。

source_issues.title: assertion type: "not-javascript" doesn't work in all cases
source_issues.evidence: 用户提供复现步骤：type=not-javascript 配合 value=(o,c)=>true 时断言应失败但实际通过。问题影响 number、function、object 等多种 value 类型，根因定位明确（handleJavascript 中 inverse 未对所有 value 类型处理）。

signals.topic: OpenAI Responses API bugs cause data loss and incorrect behavior in multi-turn tool-calling workflows
signals.summary: Six compounding bugs in the OpenAI Responses API integration cause silent data loss and incorrect behavior in multi-turn tool-calling agent workflows. Assistant text is dropped when tool calls are present, phase metadata is not preserved during parsing or serialization, reasoning params silently fail for dated model snapshots, reasoning tokens are duplicated across ThinkingBlocks, and tool call arguments are not JSON-serialized.
signals.review_reason: This is a P0 main workflow failure: multi-turn tool-calling is a primary use case for LlamaIndex agents, and these bugs cause silent data loss (assistant text dropped, phase lost) plus incorrect behavior (reasoning params silently dropped for dated model snapshots). The issue documents 6 bugs that compound to break the core agent loop for GPT-5.4 users.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Multiple bugs in llama-index-llms-openai
source_issues.evidence: Six distinct bugs in OpenAI Responses API: (1) Assistant text silently dropped when tool calls present - loses model pre-tool-call commentary in multi-turn workflows; (2) ResponseOutputMessage.phase not preserved during parsing - commentary vs final_answer distinction lost on replay; (3) phase not serialized back to API - round-trip fails; (4) Reasoning/sampling params gated on exact model name lookup - dated snapshots silently fail; (5) Reasoning tokens duplicated across all ThinkingBlocks - token accounting broken; (6) Tool call arguments not JSON-serialized. Bugs 1-3 compound for GPT-5.4-style multi-turn tool workflows causing complete data loss.

signals.topic: Ollama streaming drops thinking-only chunks causing loss of model reasoning content
signals.summary: When streaming responses from Ollama models with thinking support (DeepSeek-R1, QwQ), chunks where content=None but thinking is present are silently dropped. The guard 'if r["message"]["content"] is None: continue' skips those chunks before ThinkingBlock accumulation logic can process them. Non-streaming chat() works correctly - only streaming paths are affected.
signals.review_reason: Significant experience degradation: thinking content is a core part of model reasoning for DeepSeek-R1 and similar models. The bug silently drops all thinking content during streaming while non-streaming works correctly - inconsistent behavior that breaks streaming use cases where users need to see reasoning in real-time.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: stream_chat / astream_chat in llama-index-llms-ollama drops thinking-only chunks
source_issues.evidence: When streaming responses from Ollama models with thinking support (DeepSeek-R1, QwQ), chunks where content=None but thinking is present are silently dropped. The guard 'if r["message"]["content"] is None: continue' skips those chunks before ThinkingBlock accumulation logic can process them. Non-streaming chat() works correctly - only streaming paths are affected. Users lose all thinking/reasoning content during streaming.

signals.topic: BasicMCPClient.get_prompt() fails on spec-valid MCP ContentBlock types blocking MCP tool usage
signals.summary: BasicMCPClient.get_prompt() raises NotImplementedError for EmbeddedResource and ValueError for AudioContent and ResourceLink - all spec-valid MCP ContentBlock types. Any MCP server returning these types causes get_prompt() to fail entirely instead of gracefully handling or converting them.
aliases: MCP get_prompt not implemented for all content types
signals.review_reason: Main workflow blocking issue: MCP tool integration is a core LlamaIndex feature. When a spec-compliant MCP server returns EmbeddedResource, AudioContent, or ResourceLink types (all valid per MCP spec), get_prompt() fails instead of gracefully handling or converting them. Users cannot use many real MCP servers without workarounds.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: `BasicMCPClient.get_prompt()` fails on valid MCP `ContentBlock` types
source_issues.evidence: BasicMCPClient.get_prompt() raises NotImplementedError for EmbeddedResource and ValueError for AudioContent and ResourceLink - all spec-valid MCP ContentBlock types. Any MCP server returning these types causes get_prompt() to fail entirely. Reproducer shows the official MCP reference server with a valid EmbeddedResource prompt throws NotImplementedError.

signals.topic: QueryFusionRetriever._aretrieve blocks the event loop during query generation causing async workflow failure
signals.summary: _aretrieve() calls synchronous _get_queries() which blocks on self._llm.complete() instead of awaiting an async equivalent. When num_queries > 1 (the default), this blocks the event loop during query expansion and prevents other coroutines from running concurrently. The asyncio event loop freezes during every retriever.aretrieve() call.
signals.review_reason: Main workflow blocking issue in async contexts: blocking the event loop prevents any other coroutines from running concurrently, which breaks fundamental async patterns. QueryFusionRetriever with default num_queries=4 will freeze the event loop during every query - a severe issue for any production async LlamaIndex deployment.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: `QueryFusionRetriever._aretrieve` blocks the event loop during query generation
source_issues.evidence: _aretrieve() calls synchronous _get_queries() which blocks on self._llm.complete() instead of awaiting an async equivalent. When num_queries > 1 (the default), this blocks the event loop during query expansion and prevents other coroutines from running. The repro shows an asyncio.sleep(0.1) task never gets scheduled during a retriever.aretrieve() call - it completes only after the entire LLM call finishes.

signals.topic: Windows platform failures: daemon crash, security scan path error, and missing npm binaries
signals.summary: Three distinct Windows-specific failures: (1) Daemon process dies immediately on Windows + Node 25 due to unsettled top-level await and incorrect detached spawn config; (2) Security scan emits 'The system cannot find the path specified' error due to POSIX shell syntax (/dev/null) used on Windows; (3) agentic-jujutsu npm package missing win32-x64-msvc binary, causing MODULE_NOT_FOUND on Windows.
signals.review_reason: Three independent Windows-specific failures from three different users block core functionality on Windows: the daemon cannot stay running (making the entire background service unusable), the security scan emits confusing error output, and a required npm package fails to install. These are distinct bugs with clear reproduction steps and confirmed root causes, collectively making ruflo unreliable on Windows.

source_issues.title: Daemon dies immediately on Windows + Node 25 (unsettled top-level await + detached spawn)
source_issues.evidence: Daemon reports 'started' but exits immediately on Windows. daemon status always shows STOPPED. Root cause: (1) Node 25 detects unsettled top-level await and exits; (2) detached:false on Windows means child dies with parent. Both fixes confirmed locally — after applying fixes, daemon status correctly shows RUNNING.

source_issues.title: security scan prints 'The system cannot find the path specified' on Windows
source_issues.evidence: Command 'npx @claude-flow/cli security scan --depth full' completes scan output but then emits Windows error 'The system cannot find the path specified.' Root cause: npm audit commands use '2>/dev/null' POSIX shell syntax. cmd.exe doesn't understand /dev/null. Error reproduced and confirmed tied to shell invocation, not scan logic.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Missing Windows (win32-x64-msvc) binaries for agentic-jujutsu package
source_issues.evidence: Windows users get MODULE_NOT_FOUND when running 'npx agentic-jujutsu'. Package attempts to download agentic-jujutsu-win32-x64-msvc from npm but gets 404 Not Found. Native .node file not included in main package and platform-specific package never published. Affects all Windows x64 users regardless of Node version.

signals.topic: AgentDB controllers fail to initialize — 4 MCP tools silently return errors
signals.summary: reasoningBank controller is registered but disabled (missing embedder param), and 3 other controllers (ContextSynthesizer, BatchOperations, CausalMemoryGraph bridge) are never registered at all. Four MCP tools that depend on them (agentdb_context-synthesize, agentdb_pattern-search, agentdb_batch, agentdb_causal-edge) appear in the tool list but always return errors. The failure is silent — no error is shown to users until they explicitly call the tools.
signals.review_reason: Two independent reports from different users (martineserios, ronmikailov) document that 4 core AgentDB MCP tools are broken due to missing controller registrations and a missing constructor argument. Users see these tools in the MCP tool list, expect them to work, but get silent errors. This directly blocks context synthesis, pattern search, batch memory operations, and causal graph features — all core advertised capabilities.

source_issues.title: AgentDB: 4 controllers unimplemented (ContextSynthesizer, ReasoningBank, BatchOperations, CausalMemoryGraph bridge)
source_issues.evidence: 4 MCP tools exposed in tool list but silently fail: agentdb_context-synthesize → 'ContextSynthesizer not available', agentdb_pattern-search → 'controller: unavailable', agentdb_batch → 'BatchOperations not available', agentdb_causal-edge → 'bridge not available'. Root cause traced to controller-registry.js missing registrations and reasoningBank missing embedder param.

source_issues.title: ReasoningBank controller disabled — missing embedder param in ControllerRegistry
source_issues.evidence: Root cause identified: ControllerRegistry line 564 calls new RB(this.agentdb.database) with only 1 arg, but ReasoningBank requires (db, embedder). Without embedder, constructor throws, registry records enabled:false. agentdb_pattern-store and agentdb_pattern-search fail with 'AgentDB bridge not available'. Fix confirmed: add this.createEmbeddingService() before instantiation.

signals.topic: Memory SQLite database path is CWD-relative — causes silent data loss on MCP server restart
signals.summary: The memory database is stored at {cwd}/.swarm/memory.db. When the MCP server restarts from a different working directory, it creates a new empty database. Previously stored entries appear to vanish. Data is not deleted but orphaned in the old CWD's directory.
signals.review_reason: A user documented complete reproduction steps showing that memory entries are lost when the MCP server restarts from a different CWD. The failure is silent (no error message), making the memory system appear unreliable. This undermines the core value of persistent memory storage — users cannot trust that their stored knowledge will be available in subsequent sessions.

source_issues.title: Memory SQLite database path is relative to CWD, causing data loss on MCP server restart
source_issues.evidence: Full reproduction steps provided: store entries from one CWD, restart MCP server from different CWD, memory_stats shows 0 entries. Root cause: bridge resolves path relative to process.cwd(). Workaround requires explicit path configuration. Data loss is silent — no error message, just empty results.

signals.topic: memory_search silently returns empty results due to wrong default namespace
signals.summary: memory_search defaults to namespace 'default' when no namespace parameter is provided. But entries stored via memory_store use specific namespaces (health, business, calendar, etc.), not 'default'. The SQL pre-filter excludes all entries before HNSW vector search runs, returning 0 results silently with no error message.
signals.review_reason: A user with 100+ memory entries confirmed that every memory_search call returns empty results silently due to a wrong default namespace. The search feature is completely broken for typical usage — users store data, verify it exists via memory_stats, but all searches return 0. No error message is shown. This makes the memory search feature appear entirely non-functional.

source_issues.title: memory_search defaults to namespace 'default', returning empty results when entries use named namespaces
source_issues.evidence: Root cause identified: memory-tools.js line 288 uses const namespace = input.namespace || 'default'. This applies SQL filter WHERE namespace='default' which excludes all entries stored under named namespaces. User verified 100+ entries exist via memory_stats but every search returns 0 results. Explicit namespace:'all' works. Four locations in code have the same bug.

signals.topic: ruflo init --full and init hooks are disconnected — hooks never fire without running both commands
signals.summary: ruflo init --full creates helper scripts but does not update settings.json with hook entries. ruflo init hooks creates settings.json entries but does not create the helper scripts. Users running only init (as documented) end up with non-functional hooks. The README claim that 'after running init, just use Claude Code normally' is not true.
signals.review_reason: A user documented that the advertised 'just use Claude Code normally' workflow is completely broken after running the documented init command. Hooks are never wired up. The product's core automation value proposition is not delivered out-of-the-box. This is a first-run experience failure that affects every new user.

source_issues.title: Bug: init --full and init hooks are disconnected — hooks never fire without manual wiring
source_issues.evidence: Full reproduction: after 'ruflo init --full', .claude/helpers/ has 40+ scripts but settings.json has no hooks section. Running 'ruflo init hooks' separately creates settings.json entries pointing to scripts that don't exist. User had to manually add hooks to ~/.claude/settings.json. README's 'just use Claude Code normally' claim is contradicted by actual behavior.

signals.topic: --headed flag silently ignored when session already exists
signals.summary: Passing --headed on a command targeting an existing headless session does nothing: no window appears, no error, no warning. The headed preference is frozen at daemon spawn time and ensure_daemon() returns early.
aliases: headed mode not applied to existing session
signals.review_reason: Two identical issues confirm this is a consistent regression. Blocks the primary debugging workflow — user cannot switch to headed mode without closing the session first, which defeats the purpose of session persistence. The command silently fails with no error, making it a deceptive UX failure.

source_issues.title: bug: headed silently ignored on existing session
source_issues.evidence: Reproduction: open a session with default (headless), then pass --headed on next command targeting same session — no window, no error. Workaround requires closing session first.

source_issues.title: bug: headed silently ignored on existing session
source_issues.evidence: Identical issue, closed as duplicate. Same reproduction steps and root cause (ensure_daemon() returns early, AGENT_BROWSER_HEADED frozen at spawn time).

signals.topic: Upload command cannot handle accessibility tree refs and dynamically created file inputs
signals.summary: The upload command rejects accessibility tree refs (e29) that fill and click accept, and cannot detect JavaScript-dynamically created <input type=file> elements, unlike Playwright MCP which handles both cases automatically.
signals.review_reason: Two related but distinct upload failures that together block common web interaction patterns. The API inconsistency (ref support) is a design defect — users expect uniform ref handling across all commands. The dynamic input issue directly compares unfavorably to Playwright MCP. Both verified with explicit reproduction steps against real web apps.

source_issues.title: upload command does not accept accessibility tree refs (fill/click do)
source_issues.evidence: API inconsistency: fill/click resolve refs (e26, e3) but upload only accepts CSS selectors. Explicit reproduction with Greenhouse job application form.

source_issues.title: agent-browser upload command cannot handle dynamically created file input elements
source_issues.evidence: JS-dynamically created <input type=file> elements cannot be located. Playwright MCP handles this via dialog detection; agent-browser requires manual element targeting. Blocks common patterns like meeting-canvas file uploads.

signals.topic: Rust rewrite introduced regressions in wait URL glob matching and cross-domain cookie state saving
signals.summary: The Native Rust rewrite broke wait --url glob pattern support (uses String.includes instead of actual glob matching) and save_state cross-domain cookies (uses Network.getCookies instead of Network.getAllCookies), both regressing from v0.15/v0.19 behavior.
signals.review_reason: Two confirmed regressions from the Rust rewrite. wait --url glob is a core workflow primitive that users rely on (documented in help text). save_state cross-domain cookies is a critical auth regression affecting SSO/CAS flows. Both have pinpointed root causes in the Rust code and both worked in prior versions.

source_issues.title: wait --url glob pattern matching broken after Rust rewrite
source_issues.evidence: Regression from f341c0a: wait --url uses String.includes() instead of actual glob matching, so **/settings/profile never resolves. Documentation and help text still show glob examples that don't work.

source_issues.title: save_state missing cross-domain cookies after Rust rewrite (regression from JS/Playwright version)
source_issues.evidence: Rust version uses Network.getCookies (current page only) vs JS version's Network.getAllCookies (all domains). Cross-domain SSO/CAS cookies (TGC2, DT2, nonce) are silently dropped, breaking auth state saving. Closed with acknowledged root cause.

signals.topic: Orphaned headless Chrome processes block normal Chrome after agent-browser crash
signals.summary: When an agent-browser session crashes or terminates unexpectedly, spawned Chrome processes remain as orphans holding locks on profile/socket resources, preventing the user from launching or quitting Chrome normally until manually killed.
signals.review_reason: Single issue but with severe user impact: a session crash leaves the user's own Chrome browser permanently unusable until manual process cleanup. This is a resource leak that has real-world consequences for daily workflow. count=1 but the severity and reproducibility warrant P0 — it directly prevents use of the user's primary browser.

source_issues.title: Orphaned headless Chrome processes block normal Chrome from launching
source_issues.evidence: Reproducible: start session, crash/terminate unexpectedly, Chrome becomes unresponsive or won't launch. Manual pkill -9 -f 'Google Chrome' required. Multiple process types remain (main, GPU helper, renderer, crashpad). Confirmed on macOS Apple Silicon with agent-browser v0.23.4.

signals.topic: Auto-connect attaches to blank daemon and fails to connect 8/10 times
signals.summary: In auto-connect mode, agent fails to attach 8 out of 10 times. The dashboard shows connection to a blank daemon and the attach falls back to the daemon's blank page after navigation, losing all existing tabs.
signals.review_reason: Very high failure rate (80%) in auto-connect mode which is a key user workflow for preserving authenticated sessions. The session state appears present in the dashboard but is functionally blank, causing agents to lose context. Though only one issue, the 80% failure rate is strong user impact evidence.

source_issues.title: Auto Connect inconsistency
source_issues.evidence: 80% failure rate (8/10) in auto-connect mode. Dashboard screenshot shows blank daemon despite user having multiple tabs open. Agent attach falls back to blank page after navigation. User must use manual state-save flow instead.

signals.topic: 恶意软件包通过第三方贡献者注入，导致用户安装流程被阻断
signals.summary: 第三方贡献者 ruvnet/ruflo 提交了包含 Trojan:JS/CrypoStealz.AE!MTB 恶意代码的 agent skill，导致 Windows Defender 隔离并中断了用户正在进行的 composition-patterns 和 react-best-practices 安装流程。
signals.review_reason: 用户安装主流程被真实恶意软件阻断（Windows Defender 隔离），属于关键功能不可用场景。虽然 count=1（单仓），但影响明确：安装流程中途被打断，且用户面临真实木马威胁（非推测性风险），具备明确用户影响证据。归类为 P1 而非 P0 是因为仅单条记录、影响范围限于受害用户、未见系统性反复出现。

source_issues.title: !IMPORTANT: Trojan:JS/CrypoStealz.AE!MTB Detected
source_issues.evidence: 用户正在安装 composition-patterns 和 react-best-practices 时被 Windows Defender 强制阻断并隔离，流程中途被打断。恶意包 ruvnet/ruflo 通过第三方贡献进入仓库，带有 100+ 个 agent skills，其中至少两个包含木马。用户安装体验直接被阻断，且面临真实恶意软件威胁。

signals.topic: Image upload in useChat sends images as FilePart instead of ImagePart, causing vision-capable models (Xiaomi MiMo, GLM-5, DeepSeek via OpenRouter) to silently ignore images
signals.summary: convertToModelMessages converts client-side FileUIPart (type: 'file', mediaType: 'image/*') to FilePart (type: 'file') in ModelMessage. Many vision-capable models accessed via AI Gateway or OpenRouter do not support file parts and silently ignore images.
aliases: FilePart vs ImagePart for vision models
vision model image part format incompatibility
signals.review_reason: User-impacting bug causing silent failure: vision-capable models silently ignore images when sent as FilePart instead of ImagePart. This blocks the main workflow (chat with image upload) for users of OpenRouter, AI Gateway with non-OpenAI-compatible models. Count=1 but severity is high due to silent data loss.

source_issues.title: convertToModelMessages sends images as FilePart instead of ImagePart — providers that support vision but not file parts can't see images
source_issues.evidence: Models like Xiaomi MiMo, GLM-5 (via AI Gateway), DeepSeek via OpenRouter support vision but don't support file parts. When image arrives as type: 'file', they respond as if no image was sent — silent failure, no error thrown.

signals.topic: useChat/Chat resume crashes with TypeError when resuming partial static tool calls in streaming state
signals.summary: createStreamingUIMessageState crashes with 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading split)' when resuming a chat message that contains a partial static tool call in input-streaming state.
aliases: resume stream static tool call crash
partial static tool call resume crash
signals.review_reason: Clear user-impacting bug: resume of streaming chat with partial static tool calls causes a crash (TypeError) that completely blocks the resume flow. Reproduction steps provided. Count=1 but crash is severe and affects a core streaming resume workflow.

source_issues.title: Resume of partial static tool calls crashes in createStreamingUIMessageState
source_issues.evidence: Crash occurs in createStreamingUIMessageState when resuming a chat that has a static tool call in input-streaming state. Error: 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading split)' at getStaticToolName. Includes exact reproduction steps and one-line fix.

signals.topic: Azure AI Foundry project endpoint fails (400 error) in multi-turn streaming with tools unless api-version query is manually stripped via middleware
signals.summary: @ai-sdk/azure provider sends requests with api-version query param to Azure AI Foundry project endpoint (/api/projects/<project>/openai/v1/responses), causing 400 'No tool call found' errors in multi-turn responses+tools streaming scenarios.
aliases: Azure provider Foundry v1 endpoint compatibility
signals.review_reason: User-impacting bug: Azure AI Foundry project users face 400 errors blocking multi-turn streaming with tools unless they write custom middleware. This is a workaround-inducing SDK bug that breaks core tool-calling workflow for Azure Foundry users.

source_issues.title: provider/azure: Foundry project /openai/v1/responses fails unless api-version query is removed
source_issues.evidence: Using @ai-sdk/azure 3.0.50 + ai 6.0.142 with Azure AI Foundry project endpoint. Provider sends requests to /api/projects/<project>/openai/v1/responses?api-version=v1 which causes 400 invalid_request_error 'No tool call found for function call output'. Workaround requires custom fetch middleware to strip api-version.

signals.topic: AI SDK strips empty reasoning blocks causing Bedrock API to reject responses with 'cannot modify thinking or redacted_thinking blocks' error
signals.summary: AI SDK strips 'empty' reasoning chunks from Bedrock responses. When the modified response is sent back (e.g., for validation/reasoning), Bedrock rejects it because the reasoning blocks no longer match the original response.
aliases: empty reasoning chunk removal breaking Bedrock
signals.review_reason: User-impacting bug: Bedrock API errors that block reasoning validation workflows. AI SDK strips empty reasoning chunks, causing Bedrock to reject the modified response. Previous fix (PR #13972) did not fully resolve the issue, indicating a persistent regression affecting Bedrock users.

source_issues.title: AI SDK drops "reasoning" reasoning blocks but these MUST be included for validation
source_issues.evidence: Intermittent Bedrock API errors: 'The model cannot modify thinking or redacted_thinking blocks in assistant messages. These blocks must remain as they were in the original response.' Root cause: AI SDK strips 'empty' reasoning chunks, changing the response. A previous fix (PR #13972) did not resolve the issue. Affects @ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock ^4.0.86.

signals.topic: chat.stop() fires abort signal but returns immediately without waiting for stream pipeline to terminate, causing stale/duplicate content after cancellation
signals.summary: When calling chat.stop(), the abort signal fires but the method returns before the stream pipeline fully terminates, resulting in buffered chunks arriving after caller has cleared messages, producing garbled/duplicate content.
aliases: chat.stop() early return stream not terminated
abort signal fires without waiting for stream pipeline
stream pipeline race condition on stop
signals.review_reason: User-impacting bug: chat.stop() returns before stream terminates, causing stale chunks to arrive after messages are cleared. Forces every SDK user to write complex workarounds. Severe UX degradation in clear-chat workflows where user expects immediate, clean stop.

source_issues.title: chat.stop() fires the abort signal but returns immediately without waiting for the stream pipeline to fully terminate
source_issues.evidence: chat.stop() fires the abort signal but returns immediately. The stream's internal job queue can push buffered chunks back after the caller clears messages. User had to write a complex workaround helper to wait for status to become 'ready' or 'error' before clearing. In 'clear chat' scenarios this results in gibberish arriving after clearing.

signals.topic: Multi-zone rewrites render blank page in 16.2.x despite 200 response from sub-app
signals.summary: After upgrading from 16.1.7 to 16.2.x, multi-zone rewrites to external sub-apps result in a blank white screen. The sub-app returns HTTP 200 with valid HTML, but the browser renders nothing. Regression from 16.1.7.
signals.review_reason: Regression in 16.2.x that breaks a core architectural pattern (multi-zone/monorepo proxy). Users with existing 16.1.7 setups upgrading will see their proxied sub-apps render as blank pages with no indication of the root cause. The sub-app returns 200 — the failure is invisible to the user and requires deep debugging to identify as a Next.js regression.

source_issues.title: [REGRESSION] Multi-zone rewrites render blank page in 16.2.2 (works in 16.1.7)
source_issues.evidence: Sub-app returns HTTP 200 confirmed via server logs; static assets also return 200 via asset rewrite; browser shows blank white page. Downgrading to 16.1.7 resolves immediately.

source_issues.title: [REGRESSION] Multi-zone rewrites render blank page in 16.2.2 (works in 16.1.7)
source_issues.evidence: Same repro as #92208, confirmed blank page with 200 response from sub-app in 16.2.2, works in 16.1.7.

source_issues.title: [REGRESSION] Multi-zone rewrites render blank page in 16.2.2 (works in 16.1.7)
source_issues.evidence: Duplicate of #92207/#92208 — same issue title and author.

signals.topic: OPTIONS requests to _next/static chunks return 500 error, polluting production HTTP error logs
signals.summary: Sending HTTP OPTIONS requests to static chunk URLs (e.g., _next/static/chunks/...) returns a 500 error in production builds. This is triggered automatically by bots that send OPTIONS requests, causing all Next.js production deployments to emit spurious 500 errors in their logs.
signals.review_reason: While not blocking the app from loading, 500 errors triggered by automated bot traffic pollute production error logs and can trigger error monitoring alerts. The correct behavior would be returning 405 (Method Not Allowed) — a non-5xx response that wouldn't trigger error alarms. Affects all self-hosted Next.js production deployments.

source_issues.title: 500 errors when sending OPTIONS request to _next/static/chunks/...
source_issues.evidence: OPTIONS request to _next/static/chunks/... URLs returns 500 error in production (next start). Bots automatically send OPTIONS requests, causing this error to dominate production error logs. Developer reports this is 'almost all of our 500 errors in production'. Should return 405 Method Not Allowed instead.

source_issues.title: 500 errors when sending OPTIONS request to _next/static/chunks/...
source_issues.evidence: Duplicate report confirming the same issue. OPTIONS to static chunks returns 500. Developer notes this affects all Next.js instances and is triggered by bots automatically.

signals.topic: Turbopack chunk filenames containing ~ (tilde) blocked by enterprise WAFs causing app to fail loading
signals.summary: Turbopack in 16.2.x generates chunk filenames with ~ characters (e.g., `_next/static/chunks/0259pyb~8-2~v.js`) that are flagged by enterprise WAF rules, causing 400 responses with text/html instead of the JS. The browser refuses to execute the file, breaking the app entirely.
signals.review_reason: Critical deployment blocker for enterprise self-hosted users. The app fails to load entirely in production due to WAF blocking ~ characters in chunk URLs — a change introduced in 16.2.x's Turbopack chunk naming scheme. Users must either switch to Webpack (losing Turbopack performance) or modify WAF rules, neither of which is a satisfactory solution.

source_issues.title: Turbopack chunk filenames containing ~ (tilde) blocked by enterprise WAFs
source_issues.evidence: Enterprise WAF returns 400 for any request to _next/static/chunks/*.js with ~ in filename. Browser then refuses to execute file due to MIME type mismatch (text/html returned instead of application/javascript). Workaround requires switching from Turbopack to Webpack (--webpack), forfeiting Turbopack performance gains. Affects self-hosted enterprise deployments behind standard WAF rulesets.

signals.topic: Turbopack dev server OOM: heap grows to 17GB+ during idle, then crashes with FATAL out-of-memory error
signals.summary: Next.js 16.2.1 with Turbopack dev server suffers progressive heap growth from ~500MB to 17GB+ when left idle for 20-30 minutes, eventually crashing with 'FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit'. Not reproducible with Webpack dev mode.
signals.review_reason: Dev server becomes completely unusable after 20-30 minutes of normal use, crashing with a hard OOM error. Users lose their dev server session and must restart. This is a severe memory leak in Turbopack's module evaluation paths that affects development productivity. Workaround of switching to Webpack opts out of the default development experience.

source_issues.title: Turbopack dev server OOM: heap grows to 17GB+ when idle (Next.js 16.2.1, Node 24)
source_issues.evidence: Node.js heap grows from ~500MB to 17GB+ over 20-30 minutes of idle time, then crashes with 'FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory'. Stack trace shows Turbopack module evaluation paths. Workaround NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=4096' delays but does not prevent crash. Not reproducible with Webpack (--turbopack=false).

signals.topic: Router navigation freezes after browser back/forward navigation in Next.js 16.2.x dev
signals.summary: After navigating back and then forward in the browser, the router becomes unresponsive — JavaScript on the page stops working and interactive elements (e.g., buttons with click handlers) no longer respond. Regression from 16.1.7.
signals.review_reason: Blocks user navigation workflow in the dev environment — after a common browser interaction pattern (back/forward), the entire page's JavaScript becomes non-functional. This is a severe UX regression since browser history navigation is fundamental web behavior. Users must restart the dev server to recover.

source_issues.title: Router stucks on page navigation in development
source_issues.evidence: After using browser back and forward buttons, JavaScript on the page stops working — click handlers on buttons do not fire, Dev Indicator shows incorrect state. Reproducible on 16.2.0 and 16.2.2; works correctly on 16.1.7. Minimal reproduction: visit page, click forward, click back, click forward again — JS is dead.

signals.topic: createProject API silently removes secret env vars support, breaking existing user code without major version bump or documentation warning
signals.summary: vercel.projects.createProject API 悄然移除了 secret 类型环境变量的支持，导致用户现有代码直接报错。由于缺少文档提示和版本声明，用户无法提前感知这一破坏性变更。
aliases: SDK breaking change without major version bump
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：用户调用 createProject 创建含 secret 类型环境变量的项目时直接报错；属于破坏性变更却未在 major 版本发布、未在文档中标注，用户无法提前规避；关键功能（环境变量配置）不可按预期工作。虽仅 1 条 issue，但用户明确报告生产代码受损，属于强用户影响证据，符合 P1 认定标准。

source_issues.title: [BREAKING CHANGE|DOC ISSUE]: vercel.projects.createProject no longer support secret vars so it breaks current code
source_issues.evidence: 用户明确报告现有产品代码因 API 变更直接阻断，无法再使用 secret 类型创建环境变量；文档和包类型均无任何警告或变更说明；违反语义化版本约定。

signals.topic: turbo watch does not re-run ^build dependencies when source files change
signals.summary: When running `turbo watch dev`, dependency packages that only have a build script are built once on startup via `dependsOn: ["^build"]` but are never rebuilt when their source files change. The watch loop only monitors packages with a `dev` script, breaking the expected dependency-aware behavior.
aliases: turbo watch ^build not retriggered on file change
affectedUsingTaskInputs drops ^build dependency chain for affected tasks
signals.review_reason: Two independent reports covering the same root cause: `turbo watch` and `--affected` both fail to handle `^build` dependencies correctly when source files change. Issue 12501 explicitly references docs claiming 'dependency-aware' behavior that is not delivered. Issue 12512 provides a minimal reproduction and dry-run evidence. Both cause build failures in CI/CI workflows — a clear main-flow blockage.

source_issues.title: turbo watch dev does not re-run ^build dependencies when their source files change
source_issues.evidence: Editing source files in packages with only a build script (no dev script) triggers no rebuild. `turbo watch dev --filter=web-*` runs `^build` once on startup but the watch loop never retriggers it. Verified via dry-run that the package IS in the dependency graph, and the file change is within the inputs glob, yet no re-run occurs.

source_issues.title: affectedUsingTaskInputs: ^build dependencies not included for affected tasks
source_issues.evidence: With `affectedUsingTaskInputs: true`, `turbo run build --affected` excludes the `^build` dependency `@repro/common#build` from the task graph entirely. Without a warm cache, this causes build failures because the dependency's `dist/` output doesn't exist. Reproduction repo provided.

signals.topic: turbo prune corrupts bun.lock causing bun install --frozen-lockfile to fail
signals.summary: `turbo prune --docker` produces a bun.lock that fails `bun install --frozen-lockfile`. Two distinct failure modes: (1) phantom npm packages injected into bun.lock (~700 entries like `@npmcli/*`, `@sigstore/*`); (2) wrong top-level version entries kept from removed workspaces while the surviving graph points to older versions.
aliases: turbo prune bun lockfile frozen lockfile mismatch
turbo prune phantom npm packages injected into bun.lock
turbo prune removed workspace versions kept in bun.lock
signals.review_reason: Two independent reports with distinct failure modes but same symptom: `turbo prune` breaks Docker image builds for Bun monorepos because the resulting lockfile cannot pass `bun install --frozen-lockfile`. This is a direct blocker for the documented Docker prune + Bun workflow. Both provide reproduction repos and error output.

source_issues.title: turbo prune --docker injects phantom npm packages into bun.lock (v2.8.16 regression from #12228)
source_issues.evidence: v2.8.16 regressed: `turbo prune --docker` injects ~700 phantom entries (`@npmcli/*`, `@sigstore/*`, `cacache`, `libnpm*` etc.) into the pruned bun.lock that do not exist in the original. `bun install --frozen-lockfile` correctly rejects this. Regression introduced by PR #12228. Works in 2.8.15, fails in 2.8.16. Reproduction steps provided.

source_issues.title: turbo prune --docker keeps removed-workspace versions as top-level Bun entries, breaking bun install --frozen-lockfile
source_issues.evidence: After `turbo prune @repro/backend --docker`, `bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts` fails with 'lockfile had changes, but lockfile is frozen'. The pruned bun.lock keeps newer top-level entries from the removed frontend workspace (e.g. `@reown/appkit@1.8.19`) while the surviving backend graph still references older versions (e.g. `@reown/appkit@1.7.8`). Running `bun install` silently rewrites these back. Reproduction repo provided.

signals.topic: turbo watch fails to restart interruptible persistent tasks on file changes
signals.summary: When running `turbo watch` with mixed `interruptible: true` and `interruptible: false` persistent tasks, file changes produce no reaction — interruptible tasks are not killed or restarted.
aliases: turbo watch interruptible tasks not restarted on file change
turbo watch mixed persistent tasks file watch loop broken
signals.review_reason: A specific regression in `turbo watch` with mixed interruptible/non-interruptible persistent tasks. The file-change watch loop does not trigger restarts. While only one report, the user impact is a complete blockage of the hot-reload development workflow for affected packages — the dev server never picks up source changes.

source_issues.title: `turbo watch` does not restart interruptible persistent tasks on file changes
source_issues.evidence: Both persistent tasks start correctly, but editing a file in a package with `interruptible: true` produces zero reaction — the task continues running without being restarted. No rebuild of dependencies is triggered. Reproduction repo provided. Affects `turbo@2.9.1-canary.1`.

signals.topic: turbo prune npm shallow install strategy produces inconsistent package-lock.json, breaking npm ci
signals.summary: `turbo prune --docker` with npm generates a package-lock.json that does not use the shallow install strategy, causing `npm ci` to fail with missing modules in the pruned output. The root dependency ends up at repo root while its transitive deps end up in nested folders.
aliases: turbo prune npm ci fails module not found
turbo prune npm shallow install not applied
signals.review_reason: Docker prune workflow for npm is completely broken. `npm ci` in the pruned output fails with a missing module error, which is a main-flow blockage for any CI/CD pipeline that relies on `turbo prune` for Docker image builds. The root cause (shallow install strategy not applied) is explicitly identified in the report.

source_issues.title: turbo prune: cannot install packages after pruning when using npm shallow install strategy
source_issues.evidence: After `turbo prune @foobar/analytics-endpoint --docker`, running `npm ci` in the pruned output fails with 'Cannot find module chalk' — `serverless/scripts/postinstall.js` cannot resolve `chalk`. Root cause: the generated package-lock.json is not using the shallow install strategy, so `serverless` ends up at repo root while `chalk` ends up nested in `analytics-util/` folder. Reproduction repo provided.

signals.topic: turbo watch triggers cascading restarts in deep dependency graphs, rendering TUI unreadable
signals.summary: `turbo watch` in monorepos with deep dependency graphs triggers exponential cascading restarts: when a low-level package completes its build and writes dist/, turbo detects that output as a file change and restarts all dependent packages, which then cascade further. On Windows, the rapid restart storm causes TUI text corruption (task names merged with status messages like 'devuild', 'buildommand').
aliases: turbo watch cascading task restart storm
turbo watch TUI garbled output Windows
signals.review_reason: A significant UX and correctness issue: `turbo watch` in any moderately complex monorepo (deep dependency graph) causes exponential restart cascades that make the TUI completely unreadable on Windows. The user's development loop is disrupted by a storm of kill/restart cycles. Key evidence: `turbo run dev` (without watch) is perfectly stable for the same monorepo, isolating the issue to the watch loop's output-change detection.

source_issues.title: turbo watch triggers cascading task restarts in deep dependency graphs, garbling TUI
source_issues.evidence: In a monorepo with ~30 packages and 3-4 dependency layers, `turbo watch dev` causes tasks to restart dozens of times before stabilizing. Screenshot shows TUI output with merged text: 'adjutant-backend#devuild', 'bashared/backend-auth#buildommand', 'Ld exited (1)onstants#build'. `turbo run dev` (without watch) does NOT have this problem — the same monorepo builds once cleanly. The cascade occurs both on initial startup and when editing a low-level dependency. Reproduction repo provided.

signals.topic: vercel env add/update stdin input broken in CI, --yes flag fails to suppress interactive prompts
signals.summary: The `vercel env update` command with stdin redirect (`< file`) fails with 'Invalid number of arguments' when no target is specified, despite documentation stating it should work. Similarly, `vercel env add <name> preview` with `--yes --force --non-interactive` still prompts for git branch, hanging CI environments like GitHub Actions. Both issues break non-interactive/CI workflows, forcing users to use the REST API directly as workaround.
aliases: env add update --yes flag not working
signals.review_reason: 体验显著下降: 两个issue均为CLI非交互模式失败，直接阻断CI/CD中环境变量管理的自动化。Issue #15763中CLI自身提示的命令仍触发交互，说明--yes等flag逻辑存在实现bug而非文档问题。用户被迫绕过CLI直接调用REST API，属于关键功能不可用的边缘情况。count=2满足归一化条件，标记P1。

source_issues.title: CLI: `vercel env update <name> < file` fails without target, but `--value` works
source_issues.evidence: Exact CLI error: 'Error: Invalid number of arguments. Usage: `vercel env update <name> <target> <gitbranch> < <file>`'. Stdin redirect documented to work but actually requires positional arguments. --value workaround exists but is inconvenient.

source_issues.title: CLI: `vercel env add <name> preview` always prompts for git branch even with --yes --force
source_issues.evidence: `vercel env add MY_VAR preview --value 'hello' --yes --force --token=$TOKEN` still prompts for git branch in CI. CLI's own error output suggests the exact command to run, but that command still triggers the prompt. Workaround: use Vercel REST API directly.

signals.topic: npm install --global vercel@latest fails with 404 for @vercel/python dependency, blocking CI/CD pipelines
signals.summary: When running `npm install --global vercel@latest` in CI environments (GitHub Actions, Ubuntu containers), installation crashes with a hard 404 error because the @vercel/python@6.29.0 internal dependency is not published to npm registry. Users are forced to pin to an older stable version (e.g., v50.37.0) as a workaround, breaking `latest` tag usage in automated pipelines.
aliases: vercel latest install broken in CI
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断: npm install是CI/CD流水线的基础入口，`vercel@latest`完全不可安装等同于部署工具失效。影响范围明确：所有使用`npm install --global vercel@latest`或`latest` tag的自动化流水线用户。已有可复现步骤和明确workaround证据，count=1但因影响范围覆盖所有CI用户且属于发布配置错误，标记P0。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: npm install --global vercel@latest fails with 404 Not Found for @vercel/python@6.29.0
source_issues.evidence: Full error log provided: npm error 404 Not Found - GET https://registry.npmjs.org/@vercel/python/-/python-6.29.0.tgz - Not found. Reproducible on fresh Ubuntu container and GitHub Actions runner. Workaround: pinning to v50.37.0. Issue closed same day (rapid triage).

signals.topic: CLI monorepo project selection lacks non-interactive option, blocks automation scripts and agents
signals.summary: In monorepo setups, the Vercel CLI has no command-line option to specify which project to target for a given command. This interferes with scripts and agents that need to deploy or manage specific projects without interactive prompts or ambiguity. The --project flag does not work for most commands.
signals.review_reason: 主流程部分阻断: monorepo用户在CLI自动化场景下无法指定目标项目，影响范围限于monorepo用户群体。count=1，标记P2。

source_issues.title: CLI Monorepo Forced Interaction
source_issues.evidence: User reports monorepo with multiple projects where CLI cannot specify project via command-line, interfering with scripts and agents. --project flag does not work for most commands. No workaround provided.

signals.topic: Zed settings hot reload regressed — changes to settings/keybindings/theme/git panel not applied until window reload
signals.summary: 从 v0.231.0 preview 起，Zed 失去了热重载能力。用户修改设置、快捷键、主题或 Git 面板视图后，变更不会立即生效，必须手动重载窗口才能看到效果。该问题被同一用户（FloppyDisco）在同一会话内报告了 6 次，并有一个明确的父 issue 确认为系统性回归。
signals.review_reason: 6 个独立 issue 均来自同一用户的同一会话但确认了系统性回归：Zed v0.231.0 失去了热重载能力，覆盖设置、快捷键、主题和 Git 面板四项核心交互。高频（6条）+ 主流程阻断（每次改设置都要手动重载窗口）+ 有父 issue 确认根因。属于典型的主流程阻断性体验退化。

source_issues.title: Zed no longer Hot Reloading settings and keybinding changes
source_issues.evidence: 父 issue：'If you change a setting that would normally cause a change in the UI. the setting is not implemented until the program is restarted or workspace::Reload is called. to me it seems to be fairly systemic.'

source_issues.title: UI theme does not change until window is reloaded

source_issues.title: Theme Selector not changing the theme of previous windows

source_issues.title: git panel Tree view does not change to flat view

source_issues.title: settings ui does not update with settings change
source_issues.evidence: 'if you click on a setting in the setting UI, the setting is changed, however the settings ui button does not toggle and the setting does not actually change until the window is reloaded'

source_issues.title: keybindings do not update until window reloaded
source_issues.evidence: 'if you make a change to the keybindings.json file OR change a setting in the keybindings UI. that change does not take effect until after the window is reloaded'

signals.topic: 大文件（468MB SQL）导致内存泄漏并引发系统级崩溃
signals.summary: 用户在项目中放置一个 468MB 的 SQL 文件后，Zed 的 Uncommitted Changes 功能持续消耗内存，导致 Linux Gnome 会话整体崩溃。即使关闭 Uncommitted Changes 面板，内存仍持续增长。
signals.review_reason: 虽然 count=1，但有极强的用户影响证据：468MB 文件导致内存持续增长并引发操作系统级别的 Gnome 会话崩溃，是典型的主流程阻断+系统稳定性问题。3 条用户评论进一步确认可复现。P0 优先级符合'高频+主流程阻断'中的'主流程阻断'条件，因其影响核心编辑功能可用性。

source_issues.title: Presence of big (468) MB slq file in 'Uncommited changes' lead to memory leak and crash
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告：'I exported a sql file at the root of my project, then zed used huge amount of RAM and made my Gnome session crash.' 'Closing it does nothing, RAM continues to be eaten more and more. Problem gone if I remove the file.'

signals.topic: Agent 对话未能在重启后恢复 — 上一次会话被静默覆盖

signals.review_reason: 用户 AI 对话工作流被阻断：重启 Zed 后正在进行的 Claude 会话被静默丢失。日志有明确证据证明会话存在但被跳过恢复。该问题是关键 AI 功能的核心场景失效，虽仅 1 条 issue 但影响严重，定 P1。

source_issues.title: `AgentPanel` thinks `last_active_thread` doesn't exist and overwrites it
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告：'last active thread 6940d66f-e599-4872-844b-11c7204550a0 has no metadata, skipping restoration' 导致重新打开 Zed 时原对话丢失而非恢复。日志中明确记录了会话存在但被跳过。

signals.topic: 远程项目文件下载静默失败 — 无任何错误提示
signals.summary: 在远程 Zed 项目中右键下载文件时，界面显示下载成功但实际文件未被更新或覆盖，用户不会收到任何错误提示，导致静默的数据不一致。

source_issues.title: Remote Project Download Fails Silently
source_issues.evidence: 'The download appears to succeed, but the README.md file in the Downloads directory is not updated and does not match the remote file. Expected behavior: An error should be shown if the file cannot be downloaded or overwritten'

signals.topic: 文件选择器因非 ASCII 文件名导致 panic 崩溃
signals.summary: 使用 Cmd+P 打开文件选择器并搜索时，Zed 在处理包含某些字符（尤其是国际字符）的文件名时触发 panic：'highlight index N is not a valid UTF-8 boundary'，导致编辑器崩溃。用户提供了 4 份崩溃转储，时间跨度两天，版本覆盖 v0.229.0 和 v0.230.0。
signals.review_reason: 编辑器核心功能（文件选择器）panic 崩溃，且 4 份崩溃转储跨两天两版本证明持续性。panic 位置精确（highlighted_label.rs:20 UTF-8 边界计算错误），维护者已标 priority:P1。属于关键功能不可用+主流程阻断，P1 适当。

source_issues.title: Crash in file picker: "highlight index N is not a valid UTF-8 boundary" panic in highlighted_label.rs
source_issues.evidence: 用户提供了 4 份崩溃转储（两天内跨两个版本）：'highlight index 24/34/39/36 is not a valid UTF-8 boundary'，崩溃发生在 highlighted_label.rs:20。state:reproducible 和 priority:P1 已被维护者标注。
